operation.summary: Merges two shelves by adding all books from the shelf named `other_shelf_name` to shelf `name`, and deletes `other_shelf_name`.
operation.description: Merges two shelves by adding all books from the shelf named `other_shelf_name` to shelf `name`, and deletes `other_shelf_name`. Returns the updated shelf. The book ids of the moved books may not be the same as the original books. Returns NOT_FOUND if either shelf does not exist. This call is a no-op if the specified shelves are the same.
